offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes medicines and delivery devices for people with cardiometabolic and rare lung diseases. It manufactures pharmaceuticals for its own business and under contract, and works with drugmakers to develop inhaled therapies.

quotes.quote: At MannKind, we are dedicated to transforming chronic disease through innovative, patient-centric solutions designed to fit seamlessly into daily life. Our focus is on delivering therapies for people living with cardiometabolic and orphan lung diseases such as diabetes, pulmonary hypertension and fluid overload in heart and chronic kidney disease.

Sanjay Singh is Executive Vice President of MannKind’s Technical Operations, leading our Danbury facility including oversight of our commercial and contract manufacturing. With more than 30 years of experience in pharmaceutical technical operations, he has worked with multiple technologies, delivery systems, and therapeutic areas.

primary_products.value: Rapid-acting inhaled insulin; insulin delivery patches; injectable furosemide for at-home treatment

quotes.quote: With our ultra rapid-acting inhaled insulin, Afrezza ® — featuring our innovative Technosphere ® technology — we are changing the way diabetes is treated. We are developing new ways for people with cardiometabolic and orphan lung diseases to truly thrive.
